author: Insta360
description:
Turns out you can shoot a whole travel carousel on an action cam. Also, Snapshot is criminally underused.

Welcome to Off The Record, the all-new podcast from Insta360 where we chat about everything from cameras, travel, and random tidbits from around the world.

In this episode we break down how to make full advantage of the Insta360 Ace Pro 2, as well as general tips around 360 cameras.
